arxiv-1701-05828.title: An asymptotically consistent approximant for the equatorial bending angle of light due to Kerr black holes Journal: Class. Quantum Grav.
arxiv-1701-05828.creator: Nathaniel S. Barlow, Steven J. Weinstein, Joshua A. Faber
arxiv-1701-05828.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by Nathaniel S. Barlow, Steven J. Weinstein, Joshua A. Faber. An accurate closed-form expression is provided to predict the bending angle of light as a function of impact parameter for equatorial orbits around Kerr black holes of arbitrary spin. This expression is constructed by assuring that the weak- and strong-deflection limits are explicitly satisfied while maintaining accuracy at intermediate values of impact parameter via the method of asymptotic approximants (Barlow et al, 2017 Q.

arxiv-2201-12983.title: Global calculation of two-neutrino double- β \beta decay within the finite amplitude method in nuclear density functional theory
arxiv-2201-12983.creator: Nobuo Hinohara, Jonathan Engel
arxiv-2201-12983.description: Abstract Two-neutrino double-beta ( 2 ​ ν ​ β ​ β 2\nu\beta\beta ) decay has been used to constrain the neutron-proton part of effective interactions, which in turn is used to compute the nuclear matrix elements for neutrinoless double-beta decay, the observation of which would have important consequences for fundamental physics.

arxiv-2207-05534.title: Resolving Power of Visible to Near-Infrared Hybrid β \beta -Ta/NbTiN Kinetic Inductance Detectors
arxiv-2207-05534.creator: Kevin Kouwenhoven 1,2, Daniel Fan 3, Enrico Biancalani 5, Steven A.H. de Rooij 1,2, Tawab Karim 4, Carlas S. Smith 4, Vignesh Murugesan 1, David J. Thoen 2, Jochem J.A. Baselmans 1,2, Pieter J. de Visser 1
arxiv-2207-05534.description: Abstract Kinetic Inductance Detectors (KIDs) are superconducting energy-resolving detectors, sensitive to single photons from the near-infrared to ultraviolet. We study a hybrid KID design consisting of a beta phase tantalum ( β \beta -Ta) inductor and a NbTiN interdigitated capacitor (IDC). The devices show an average intrinsic quality factor Q i Q_{i} of 4.

arxiv-2211-12566.title: Coverage of Credible Intervals in Bayesian Multivariate Isotonic Regression Thanks: The research was supported in part by NSF Grant number DMS-1916419.
arxiv-2211-12566.creator: Kang Wang, Subhashis Ghosal
arxiv-2211-12566.description: Abstract We consider the nonparametric multivariate isotonic regression problem, where the regression function is assumed to be nondecreasing with respect to each predictor. Our goal is to construct a Bayesian credible interval for the function value at a given interior point with assured limiting frequentist coverage.

arxiv-2407-14075.title: Domain wall constraints on the doublet left-right symmetric model from pulsar timing array data
arxiv-2407-14075.creator: Dhruv Ringe
arxiv-2407-14075.description: Abstract Recent evidence of a stochastic gravitational wave (GW) background found by NANOGrav and other pulsar timing array (PTA) collaborations has inspired many studies looking for possible sources. We consider the hypothesis that the GW signature is produced by domain walls (DWs) arising in the doublet left-right symmetric model (DLRSM) due to the spontaneous breaking of the discrete parity symmetry.

arxiv-2502-15414.title: Modal Clustering for Categorical Data
arxiv-2502-15414.creator: Noemi Corsini, Giovanna Menardi
arxiv-2502-15414.description: Abstract Despite the inherent lack of a ground truth in clustering, a broad consensus is overall acknowledged in defining the concept of cluster in the continuous setting. Conversely, this remains controversial in the presence of categorical data. We propose a novel notion of cluster based on the dual concepts of high frequency and variable association.

arxiv-2503-05520.title: Removing Geometric Bias in One-Class Anomaly Detection with Adaptive Feature Perturbation
arxiv-2503-05520.creator: Romain Hermary Vincent Gaudillière Abd El Rahman Shabayek Djamila Aouada
arxiv-2503-05520.description: Abstract One-class anomaly detection aims to detect objects that do not belong to a predefined normal class. In practice, training data lack those anomalous samples; hence, state-of-the-art methods are trained to discriminate between normal and synthetically-generated pseudo-anomalous data. Most methods use data augmentation techniques on normal images to simulate anomalies.

arxiv-2505-06941.title: When are Hopf algebras determined by integer sequences?
arxiv-2505-06941.creator: Nicolas Andrews, Lucas Gagnon, Félix Gélinas, Eric Schlums, Mike Zabrocki
arxiv-2505-06941.description: Abstract . We study the category of graded Hopf algebras that are free noncommutative, cocommutative, graded and connected from the perspective of the sequences of dimensions of the graded pieces. We show that a Hopf algebra exists with a given sequence of graded dimensions if and only if the “INVERTi” transformation of the sequence is nonnegative.

arxiv-2511-02869.title: Analysis of AdvFusion: Adapter-based Multilingual Learning for Code Large Language Models
arxiv-2511-02869.creator: Amirreza Esmaeili, Fahd Seddik, Yongyi Ji, Fatemeh Fard, Fuxiang Chen
arxiv-2511-02869.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Amirreza Esmaeili, Fahd Seddik, Yongyi Ji, Fatemeh Fard, Fuxiang Chen. Programming languages can benefit from one another by utilizing a language model for software engineering tasks. Full fine-tuning and Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) of Code Language Models (Code-LMs) has been explored for multilingual knowledge transfer. AdapterFusion is a PEFT architecture that aims to enhance task performance by leveraging information from multiple programming languages, but primarily focuses on the target programming language.

pmc-11356203.title: The Overload Effect on the Crack Tip Damage Mechanism in a 7075 Aluminum Alloy
pmc-11356203.creator: Changji Xie, Zhanguang Zheng, Li Li, Teng Sun
pmc-11356203.description: In the serviced components of a 7075 aluminum alloy, the propagation of fatigue crack can be retarded because of the overload effect; however, the corresponding retardation mechanisms are complex. To provide further insights into the retardation mechanisms of 7075 aluminum alloys, this study addresses the crack tip damage response of a cracked 7075 aluminum alloy under an overload effect.

pmc-11456880.title: Exploring social determinants of health on chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy severity in ovarian cancer: An integrative review
pmc-11456880.creator: Chisom O Odii, David E Vance, Fiona B A T Agbor, Amanda Jenkins, Ellen M Lavoie Smith
pmc-11456880.description: Highlights•The review used the CSDH framework to identify key determinants of CIPN severity in ovarian cancer patients.•Aerobic exercise may reduce CIPN symptoms, though findings are limited by study demographics and self-reports.•Stress and lack of social support are associted with worsened CIPN severity, emphasizing mental health's role in outcomes.•Hypothetical examples showed how socioeconomic status and healthcare access affect CIPN symptom management.

pmc-11643471.title: Design of a Deep Learning-Based Metalens Color Router for RGB-NIR Sensing
pmc-11643471.creator: Hua Mu, Yu Zhang, Zhenyu Liang, Haoqi Gao, Haoli Xu, Bingwen Wang, Yangyang Wang, Xing Yang
pmc-11643471.description: Metalens can achieve arbitrary light modulation by controlling the amplitude, phase, and polarization of the incident waves and have been applied across various fields. This paper presents a color router designed based on metalens, capable of effectively separating spectra from visible light to near-infrared light. Traditional design methods for meta-lenses require extensive simulations, making them time-consuming.

pmc-12524117.title: Outcomes of Endoscopic Resection of Circumferential Colorectal Laterally Spreading Lesions: A Western Experience
pmc-12524117.creator: Gianluca Andrisani, Mattia Brigida, Giulio Antonelli, Cesare Hassan, Chiara Taffon, Andrea D’Amico, Virginia Gregorio, Giovanni Parente, Michele Cicala, Antonio Facciorusso, Francesco Maria Di Matteo, Naohisa Yoshida
pmc-12524117.description: Background: Circumferential or near-circumferential colorectal lesions are challenging to remove endoscopically; therefore, they are often surgically managed. There are limited data on the outcomes of endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD) for these lesions, usually from Eastern settings, where ESD is more well established.

pmc-12607036.title: Higher viremia and pathogenesis of human adenovirus 7 is likely associated to enhanced disruption of junction integrity
pmc-12607036.creator: Jing Zhou, Qigao Chen, Bolin Cheng, Lianzhong Li, Yihao Yang, Yongping Lin
pmc-12607036.description: Highlights•Distinct Viral Trafficking Patterns: HAdV-7 exhibits unrestricted bidirectional entry and release in endothelial cells, unlike HAdV-3, which may enhance systemic dissemination. This contrasts with epithelial cells, where both viruses release apically despite bidirectional entry.•Superior Replication Efficiency: HAdV-7 replicates more robustly than HAdV-3 in both cell types, correlating with its clinical association with higher viremia and severe pediatric outcomes.

pmc-12783163.title: Recent progress of NIR light-controlled microneedles and therapeutic applications: A review study
pmc-12783163.creator: Nafiseh Farhadian, Reza Abachizadeh, Shaghayegh Kouhestani
pmc-12783163.description: Transdermal drug delivery presents an appealing alternative to traditional administration methods like oral and injection routes, as it circumvents first-pass metabolism, minimizes pain and infection risks, and enhances patient compliance. Nonetheless, the skin barrier remains a significant obstacle to delivering most medications through the skin.

pmc-12830696.title: A PIKAN-based model for the prediction of the temperature fields of castings
pmc-12830696.creator: Qichao Zhao, Baiqiao Wang, Jinwu Kang
pmc-12830696.description: In the casting process, solving various physical quantities centered on the temperature field through numerical simulation is very helpful for optimizing the process. The rapid development of deep learning technology offers potential for industrial applications and can represent a new simulation methodology. This study proposes a PIKAN model that groups spatiotemporal parameters and inputs them through an MLP model.

pmc-13093719.title: Where Are You From? Finding the Origin of the Recently Observed Sprat in Iceland Using a Panel of SNPs
pmc-13093719.creator: María Quintela, Roger Lille‐Langøy, Christophe Pampoulie, Jón Sólmundsson, Fernando Ayllon, Kevin A Glover, Florian Berg, Cecilie Kvamme
pmc-13093719.description: The European sprat is a small pelagic fish characterized by genetically distinct populations including (a) the Norwegian fjords, (b) the Baltic Sea, (c) an oceanic component ranging from the North Sea, Kattegat–Skagerrak, Celtic Sea and Bay of Biscay, as well as the southern groups such as (d) the Mediterranean (Adriatic) and (e) the Black Sea.

pmc-13225486.title: Tuberculosis disease burden in China, Japan, and South Korea: A population-based observational study of trends from 1990 to 2023 and predictions for 2035
pmc-13225486.creator: Huan Yao, Yujie Qian, Zhi Xu
pmc-13225486.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Tuberculosis (TB) remains a leading infectious killer worldwide, with the World Health Organization End TB Strategy targeting 90% and 95% reductions in incidence and mortality by 2035. Long-term comparative analyses across China, Japan, and South Korea remain lacking. This study aimed to systematically analyze trends in the TB disease burden in China, Japan, and South Korea from 1990 to 2023 and project future burden trajectories through 2035.

pmc-13426269.title: Controlled Precursor Differentiation Enables Palladium-Catalyzed Divergent Carbonylation of Cyclobutenols
pmc-13426269.creator: Yu-Kun Liu, Peng Yang, Hefei Yang, Jiajun Zhang, Xiao-Feng Wu
pmc-13426269.description: Controlling reaction selectivity is a central challenge in synthetic chemistry, particularly when multiple competing reactivity modes coexist within a single substrate. Existing strategies generally rely either on selectivity control during substrate activation or on downstream divergence from a common intermediate. However, these paradigms are less effective when distinct precursor states can independently evolve into distinct reaction manifolds.

pmc-13452150.creator: S Souguel, AMRA Ndiaye, G Grine, H Makoudi, J-F Maillard, S Bedjaoui, Y Laidoudi, B Davoust, M Drancourt
